title: Nope.avi
blurb: Flat, final, and delivered in a Texas drawl by the Team Fortress 2 Engineer, who has clearly already thought about it. Nope.avi is one of the earliest immortal shitposts on YouTube — a single word, a single frame, no elaboration whatsoever. It established a grammar of minimal refusal that the internet still runs on. Play it at requests, at dares, at Mondays, at anything deserving a one-word veto with no reasoning attached. A founding document of meme audio. Still the most efficient no available.
origin: The Engineer's 'nope' from Team Fortress 2, immortalized by nope.avi.
